stops.note: a chariot, one of the pieces in the ancient game of chess; the exact meaning of the original term is uncertain
Persian 'rukh', chariot, the original form of the chess piece
carried into Medieval Latin from Arabic as chess spread into Europe
carried into French chess vocabulary from Medieval Latin
settled as the English name for the chess piece shaped like a tower, from Old French roc
stops.meaning: a chess piece moving in straight lines

current_meaning: a chess piece, also called a castle, that moves horizontally or vertically
